1.consolidated_definition: Llegar a una fiesta sin ser invitado. “En la boda de mi hermana hubo más paracaidistas que invitados.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: To arrive at a party uninvited; to crash a party. "There were more parachutists than invited guests at my sister's wedding."
